beats.say: Hi! Many people reach official sites by searching, not by typing the address. Scammers know this too.
They buy ads to appear at the very top. Such a result has a small word next to it: Sponsored.

body.text: Vatandash Portal: get your certificate in 5 minutes

beats.say: A fake site looks very much like the real one: one letter different, an extra word, or another ending.
Check the official address once and bookmark it. Then always open it from there.

scenes.prompt: Find the dangerous spots in the search results.

body.text: Official site. Get your certificate in 5 minutes

spots.label: Ad label
spots.explain: This result was paid to be at the top. Scammers can buy ads too, so never use an ad to sign in.

spots.label: Extra word
spots.explain: The word gov was added to the address, but the ending is different. The official portal's address ends in gov.az.

spots.label: Fake official label
spots.explain: Anyone can write the words official site. The end of the address shows what is official, not the text.

spots.label: Letter swap
spots.explain: Two letters in the word portal have swapped places. It is hard to notice when you are in a hurry.

question.prompt: You sign in to the citizen portal often. What is the safest way?

options.label: I check the official address once and bookmark it
options.feedback: Right. A bookmark opens the same address every time, and ads drop out of the picture.

options.label: I search every time and press the first result
options.feedback: The first result may be an ad. Scammers count on exactly this habit.

options.label: I use the link that came by SMS
options.feedback: Anyone can send a link by SMS. Open the official site yourself.

scenes.explain: Bookmark the sites you use often. Then search results and ads cannot fool you.

scenes.title: Downloading a program
scenes.intro: You have an online meeting tomorrow and need to download the Gorush app. You start with a search.

steps.label: Download Gorush: search results
steps.say: At the top is an ad, and below it is the app's own site.

actions.label: Sponsored: gorus-app-download.example.net
actions.feedback: The ad took you to a different site. It is not too late: look at the address.

actions.label: gorus.example: official site
actions.feedback: Right. You skipped the ad and opened the app's own site.

steps.label: Gorush: free download
steps.say: The page looks a lot like the real site. Look at the address.

actions.label: Download
actions.feedback: This site does not belong to the app's maker. An installer from here cannot be trusted.

actions.label: Close the tab
actions.feedback: The address was not the app's own site. Go to the official site yourself.

actions.label: Check the address
actions.feedback: The name looks similar, but the domain is different. Do not trust this site.

steps.say: The file has downloaded. Will you open it?

actions.label: Open
actions.feedback: Along with the app, this installer sets up a program that steals passwords. Never open a file from a fake site.

actions.label: Delete
actions.feedback: Right. Delete the file, tell technical support, and get the app from the official site.

body.text: GorusSetup_2026.exe tried to read the passwords saved in your browser.

steps.say: The antivirus found something. Act fast now.

actions.label: Disconnect from the network and call technical support
actions.feedback: Right. Unless your procedure says otherwise, disconnect the computer without shutting it down and call at once.

actions.label: Close and keep working
actions.feedback: The program keeps running and can send out your passwords. Report it right away.

steps.label: Gorush: download for your computer
steps.say: This is the app's own site.

actions.label: Ask technical support to install it
actions.feedback: That is the best way. On a work computer, technical support installs programs.

actions.label: Download
actions.feedback: Right, this is the official site. On a work computer, check your technical support rules first.

points: To sign in, use a bookmark, not an ad
Read the end of the address and compare it with the official one
Get programs only from the official site or from technical support
